notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: reviewed_by stays null, the R2 hardware backend is refused until a human signs it, and no hardware run is claimed. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the package is a direct Driver with native.py, not a SerialDriver, because cetoniSerial.py builds framed binary commands (opcode, node id, CANopen index/subindex, CRC-16 and DLE byte stuffing) instead of text lines; the card's helper/decision cannot express that wire syntax. The card's mock_strategy preferred upstream-sim, but the upstream FakeSyringe (cetoniSerial.py:472-484) only prints and overrides read/write with unrelated signatures; fake.py is a deterministic package fake that models the Syringe methods the driver uses. NOT COVERED: any hardware or serial timing, the real CRC/frame exchanges, a second syringe on a shared serial line (native.py accepts ser/node but the fake serves one object), fault clearing (the clone only points at a manual page not present in the clone), valve plumbing, and flow calibration. The site must supply the syringe volume, node id, travel range, flow range and velocity range; every numeric bound is Limit.operator_required because no text of the clone states one for a configured pump. flow_rate is derived from the velocity register with the inverse of the upstream setFlowRate conversion, so it reports the value after the upstream integer rounding. dispensed_volume for a reverse (aspirate) command is the volume moved, not a positive dispense. The e-stop and the safe-state action x-cap.bennomeier.stop_pump.v1 both write control word 0x06 to 0x6040; no independent physical e-stop is claimed.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-30; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package.
